documentation.content: A DivvyAI collector or data checker execution failed. Open https://console.cloud.google.com/run/jobs?project=divvy-ai and inspect the failed execution and its logs.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.labels.project_id="divvy-ai" AND resource.labels.location="us-central1" AND resource.labels.job_name=monitoring.regex.full_match("divvyai-(collector|dbt-checks)") AND metric.labels.result="failed"
